designacao: Guitarra de Lisboa de João Palmeiro, 1994, feita para Ron Fernandez

fontes.citacao: This instrument was made for me by Senhor Palmeiro. I carefully kept it in my personal collection

factos.valor: Tampo de abeto (spruce), escala de pau-santo (rosewood), nogueira portuguesa (Portuguese Walnut); acabamento a goma-laca, afinação e trastos por Ron Fernandez

fontes.citacao: Below are 2 photos of a João Palmeiro Lisboa style guitar made in 1994. It has a spruce soundboard, rosewood fingerboard, Portuguese Walnut. French Polished Finish, set-up and fret refinement by Ron Fernandez.
